decisions.reason: As a sheet preparation module that extends the existing postpress portfolio and supports the firm's automation path, it remains a good fit for the core business.
The B2 multifinisher is close to the firm's established offer and was highlighted as a flagship, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn after remaining in the range.
The hybrid saddle stitcher matches the firm's booklet-making and binding strengths and helps preserve a broad, credible finishing portfolio for printers.
Although it is less prominently marketed than the main systems, the folding add-on complements modular installations and has demonstrated customer use, so keeping it is still the more likely choice.
